items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher On Strong Eurozone Activity Data
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Thursday, Sep, 24 2026 US market futures are pointing slightly higher this morning, with E-mini S&P 500 contracts up 0.1%. The main fuel is stronger European activity data. The Eurozone Composite PMI sits at 53.1, a three and a half year high that signals businesses are busier, which can support global demand for US manufacturers and tech suppliers. items.title: Why CrowdStrike (CRWD) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of cybersecurity platform provider CrowdStrike (NASDAQ:CRWD) jumped 4.5% in the afternoon session as it broke out to a fresh 52-week high, extending a multi-session rally.

items.title: Trump Downplayed AI Safety Concerns, but His Investment Portfolio Bought Cybersecurity Stocks
items.summary: President Donald Trump has called artificial-intelligence safety fears a “hoax.”  The president’s latest financial disclosure for July shows his portfolio bought stocks of cybersecurity companies, which address the growing need for protection as AI keeps developing.  Both the White House and the Trump Organization said Trump’s stock and bond portfolio is independently managed by third-party financial institutions.

items.summary: Today, Sept. 23, 2026, bond yields and geopolitical tensions weigh on U.S. indexes, while cybersecurity stocks rally.

items.title: Stocks Slump as Wall Street Shifts Risk-Off
items.summary: Stocks declined as the tone on Wall Street shifted away from risk amid mounting geopolitical uncertainties. The downturn marked a breather from the recent tech stock rally. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite dove 1%, pulling back from the record high it set the session prior.

items.title: Cybersecurity Stocks Rally While Large-Cap Tech Slides: CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, Okta, and Palantir Each Gain 4%
items.summary: While mega-cap tech names slide Wednesday morning, a tight cluster of cybersecurity stocks is breaking away from the pack in a move that has nothing to do with company earnings and everything to do with where investors are hiding.

items.title: Is CrowdStrike (CRWD) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for CrowdStrike (CRWD) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?
